baseline.formation_definition: Unchanged retreat-inclusive completed reversal recognition; retain all chains, no expiry, size filter, winner selection or deduplication
baseline.timing: Decision at completed parent event known_at; do not treat intermediate candle availability as role recognition. Preserve v1 historical evidence; any new stage metadata distinguishes candle_known_at and role_known_at

candidate_data.verification_status: Not yet verified for this selection run; no frozen Dataset identity certified
candidate_data.source_construction: Existing exact canonical one-minute-to-UTC15m derivation used for B1; no silent switch to provider-native15m
required_before_selection: Verify actual request/plan evaluated exposure ranges, not merely Dataset extents; no protected2024/sealed-holdout access
Verify retained same-lineage history, completeness, availability clocks and derivation using bounded existing-source capability
If complete retained history exists, acquire nothing; otherwise only explicitly authorized missing ranges inside the exact candidate bounds
Freeze and verify Dataset ID/hash, canonical source identity, normalization/input hashes and commit watermark
Confirm qualified source identity and coordinate heavy-operation ownership with engineering
candidate_data.finite_origin_population: Recognition begins at the declared origin, with no reset at block boundaries. Pre-origin formation ancestry is outside the input; no full-history stationary-recognition claim

population.cases: Every unchanged completed chain whose decision known_at lies in the half-open evaluation decision range; retain invalid-feature and unmatched chains as explicit records
population.controls: Same canonical source ordinary15m closes with no completion at that exact decision clock. Pending references and prior completions allowed. Later completion does not exclude, censor, relabel or rematch
population.control_low: For a case with n formation candles inclusive, candidate control low is the minimum low over exactly n consecutive own candles ending at its close
population.case_geometry: E is completion close; L is minimum formation low through completion inclusive; r=(E-L)/E. Both boundaries are equidistant from E: lower L and upper E+(E-L)
population.control_geometry: Own E and own trailing-n L; same boundary construction; never transfer absolute case prices or future information
population.invalid: Retain and flag missing/noncontinuous required history, nonfinite values, sigma<=0 or E<=L; no silent removal from all-case/all-moment coverage

features.index_convention: t is decision candle close index in the continuous15m canonical input; C[j] is the close at index j
features.sigma: sqrt(mean over j=1..96 of log(C[t-j]/C[t-j-1]) squared)); uses97 preceding closes and excludes decision candle
features.exact_stratum: Number of distinct completed decision clocks in the preceding12 bars, excluding the current clock:0,1,2+
diagnostics_only: q=r/(sigma*sqrt(12)); never add derived q to calipers or matching distance
formation duration/candle count, calendar time and prior-completion activity
features.availability: All matching and diagnostic values computed from the member's own decision-time prefix only; no outcome labels or first-passage calculations

matching.threshold_status: Fixed inherited design constants for one feasibility assessment; no demonstrated feasibility, power or error-control justification; never relax them to rescue coverage
matching.ratio_convention: larger positive value / smaller positive value; inclusive upper caliper
matching.reuse_scope: Global across blocks and different n; preserve all unmatched cases and rejection reasons

separate_history_and_dependence.within_pair_only: Require disjoint closed direct input-plus-nominal-support intervals for the two members of each candidate pair
separate_history_and_dependence.direct_support_start: Earliest actual candle open needed for formation/trailing n, sigma, prior movement and preceding-completion feature
separate_history_and_dependence.direct_support_end: Decision clock+12bars, fixed nominal support only; no touch scanning or realized-time shortening
separate_history_and_dependence.across_pairs: Overlap is allowed and recorded; do not claim independent pairs
separate_history_and_dependence.recognition_ancestry: Retain true reference/history dependencies separately from direct price support; conservatively connect to declared recognition origin if ancestry is not fully represented
separate_history_and_dependence.component_graph: Edges for intersecting actual support intervals, matched pair membership or shared recognition ancestry; transitive connected components. Do not invent support in gaps between distant matched members
separate_history_and_dependence.report: Direct and ancestry-aware component sizes/spans, shared completion clocks, same-day concentration, source-history limitations and potential giant component. InverseHHI is not independent sample size

weighting_and_coverage.full_population_weight: Each of T_all completion clocks gets1/T_all; each of k_all chains there gets1/(T_all*k_all)
weighting_and_coverage.matched_population_weight: For describing the matched population, each of T_matched clocks having at least one matched chain gets1/T_matched; each of k_matched matched chains there gets1/(T_matched*k_matched)
weighting_and_coverage.partial_moments: Retain and separately report moments with some but not all chains matched; unmatched chains remain explicit, never recoded as paired
coverage_outputs: All-chain and feature-eligible-chain counts and matched/unmatched reasons
All completion clocks, clocks with any match, fully matched clocks, partially matched clocks and no-match clocks
Completion-moment-weighted retained mass relative to the full population, not only fraction of clocks with any match
Per-block, UTCday and duration-stratum coverage; strata[0,3),[3,12),[12,48),[48,infinity)hours are diagnostic partitions, not gates
Full versus eligible versus matched context, barrier risk, duration and calendar distributions, with diagnostics separated from matching dimensions
Control distributions with matched completion-moment weights; report moment-weighted and raw chain counts without treating either as independent samples
weighting_and_coverage.no_arbitrary_scientific_gates: Do not enforce200pairs,90percentcoverage,80percentstratumcoverage,20days orSMD0.10 as pass/fail authority. Report observed coverage/balance/descriptive concentration instead
weighting_and_coverage.claim_limit: The selected population is matched common-support chains/moments only. A small or different subset does not support a conclusion about all formations. Feasibility is reported with explicit limitations, not rescued by tuning

stop_conditions: Unverified exposure, source lineage, availability, frozen Dataset identity or source qualification
Required history/gap failure or exceeded declared execution bound
Material protocol ambiguity requiring a user decision
execution_bounds.publication: One auditable selection report and frozen manifest of cases, pairs, exclusions, features, weights and support/dependence only; no outcome classes, first touches, forward returns or future-path summaries
